title: Composition and camera
summary: The layout in solid mode around the centre of the scene: a low shot with the mushroom close on the left turned towards the camera, the bomb on the right with its key towards the back, the pipe behind in the middle; each object lowered into the grass. A camera (Shift+A) placed low in front, a 35 mm lens, and depth of field focused on the mushroom with a low f-stop so the pipe and bomb blur.

objects.name: Camera
objects.description: low shot, 35 mm, focused on the mushroom

expected_result: From low in the grass: the red spotted mushroom big on the left and sharp, the green pipe behind in the middle and the bomb on the right, softly blurred.

steps.note: top view: the pipe at the back, in the middle
the mushroom close on the left; R Z so it looks at the camera; G Shift+Z closer
G Z down so it sits in the grass
the bomb on the right, its key towards the back
Shift+A > Camera; Numpad 0; N > View > Lock Camera to View to place it low in front; focal length 35 mm (closest to how we see)
Depth of Field: focus on the mushroom, F-stop down: only its line is sharp
